breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not scatter force across every open loop. Fierce calm is Monday composure: charge first, body second, journal third, two must-dos only. Security skim when ready. Admin only after the morning has already won. One breath, one move, one clear next step. Today’s named gate is the insurance portal. Cross it once, then the board stays quiet.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Monday: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Cloudy outside; tempo inside before the portal. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time. Optional: Front Clips / Back Clips if you want a second RipStick move.
